channel.title: Common Ground
channel.description: On shared understanding in an age of fragmentation

item.title: Post 0014 — May 3, 2026
item.dc:creator: Common Ground
item.description: Even when something is difficult to understand, it does not mean
item.content:encoded:
Even when something

is difficult to understand,

it does not mean

it cannot be understood.

Some things

require

more careful attention...

not all at once,

but over time.

And a willingness

to look again

beyond

what first appears.

item.title: Post 0013 — April 26, 2026
item.dc:creator: Common Ground
item.description: When we act on what only seems clear, we begin to shape
item.content:encoded:
When we act

on what only seems clear,

we begin to shape

outcomes

we do not fully understand.

Some problems ease.

Others take new form.

And some grow

more difficult

over time.

Not because we failed to act,

but because we acted

before we could see

clearly.

item.title: Post 0012 — April 19, 2026
item.dc:creator: Common Ground
item.description: What we see is not only shaped by what is there.
item.content:encoded:
What we see

is not only shaped

by what is there.

It is shaped

by what we have lived.

By what we have learned

to notice.

And what we have learned

to ignore.

So before we try

to change anything,

we must be willing

to look again

and see it

more clearly.

item.title: Post 0011 — April 12, 2026
item.dc:creator: Common Ground
item.description: When we cannot see how things connect, we begin to rely
item.content:encoded:
When we cannot see

how things connect,

we begin to rely

on what seems to make sense.

Quick explanations.

Familiar patterns.

Clear conclusions.

They help us move forward.

But they are not always

the whole picture.

And over time,

what we see

can begin to stand in

for what is true.

item.title: Post 0010 — April 5, 2026
item.dc:creator: Common Ground
item.description: Sometimes things feel harder than they should. Effort increases,
item.content:encoded:
Sometimes things feel harder

than they should.

Effort increases,

but progress does not.

Small steps

take more time.

Simple tasks

become complicated.

And the reason

is not always visible.

item.title: Post 0009 — March 29, 2026
item.dc:creator: Common Ground
item.description: When many parts come together, what they produce
item.content:encoded:
When many parts

come together,

what they produce

is not always easy to see.

Over time,

the connections between them

grow harder to follow.

And what we experience

can feel simpler

than what is actually there.

item.title: Post 0008 — March 22, 2026
item.dc:creator: Common Ground
item.description: When what we carry is difficult for long enough, we begin to look
item.content:encoded:
When what we carry

is difficult for long enough,

we begin to look

for someone to blame.

Sometimes ourselves.

Sometimes each other.

But sometimes difficulty

is built into the way

things are arranged.

And no amount of individual effort

can fully compensate for that alone.

item.title: Post 0007 — March 15, 2026
item.dc:creator: Common Ground
item.description: Not every burden originates in the person carrying it. Sometimes what we carry
item.content:encoded:
Not every burden

originates in the person carrying it.

Sometimes what we carry

has been building

for a long time —

quietly,

around us.

Naming it

is not an accusation.

It is the beginning

of seeing

more clearly.

item.title: Post 0006 — March 8, 2026
item.dc:creator: Common Ground
item.description: Suffering does not disappear because we refuse to name it. It remains — in posture, in tone.
item.content:encoded:
Suffering does not disappear

because we refuse to name it.

It remains — in posture, in tone.

In how quickly we assume the worst.

We do not carry it well

by denying it.

Not by numbing it.

But by admitting

that it is something we carry —

without letting it make us smaller.

item.title: Post 0005 — March 1, 2026
item.dc:creator: Common Ground
item.description: None of us are born with full awareness of what we will carry. That awareness comes later.
item.content:encoded:
None of us are born

with full awareness of what we will carry.

That awareness comes later.

Often slowly.

Often without our choosing.

Often through suffering.

item.title: Post 0004 — February 22, 2026
item.dc:creator: Common Ground
item.description: Disagreement is part of being human. When strain lasts too long, distance grows.
item.content:encoded:
Disagreement is part of being human.

When strain lasts too long,

distance grows.

Distance makes it easier

to stop seeing one another clearly.

If it lingers,

that distance becomes

the burden we carry.

item.title: Post 0003 — February 15, 2026
item.dc:creator: Common Ground
item.description: When systems stay under strain for too long, people don’t become worse — they become narrower.
item.content:encoded:
When systems stay under strain for too long,

people don’t become worse —

they become narrower.

This narrowing isn’t a failure of character.

It’s a pressure response.

Narrowing changes

how we see.

And how we treat one another.

item.title: Post 0002 — February 8, 2026
item.dc:creator: Common Ground
item.description: You don’t have to agree. You don’t have to choose a side. You don’t have to like everything that follows.
item.content:encoded:
You don’t have to agree.

You don’t have to choose a side.

You don’t have to like

everything that follows.

You just have to stay human

while we figure out what comes next.

item.title: Post 0001 — February 1, 2026
item.dc:creator: Common Ground
item.description: This is not a movement. Not a party. Not a demand for agreement.
item.content:encoded:
This is not a movement.

Not a party.

Not a demand for agreement.

It is a place to stand when the noise gets loud and the ground feels unsteady.

This will move slowly.

On purpose.
